# RTU Solutions
> Free and premium study material for Rajasthan Technical University students.

## About
RTU Solutions provides RTU Notes, PYQ Solutions, Important Questions and Video Lectures for all engineering branches and semesters.

## Content
- RTU Notes: Branch and semester wise notes
- PYQ Solutions: Previous year question paper solutions
- Important Questions: Exam-focused question banks
- Video Lectures: YouTube video explanations
